key_concepts: Matter has weight and occupies space
Matter exists as solid, liquid, or gas
Solids have their own shape and can be held
Solid molecules are tightly packed and move only slightly
Solids can be described by color
Solids can be described by shape
Solids can be described by size or mass
Solids can be described by texture
Solids have weight measured in kilograms or grams
Solids have volume computed as length × width × height
Rulers, meter sticks, and tape measures measure size
